let angle = 0
basic.forever(function () {
    pins.i2cWriteNumber(
    32,
    0,
    NumberFormat.UInt8BE,
    true
    )
    angle = pins.i2cReadNumber(32, NumberFormat.UInt8BE, false)
    pins.servoWritePin(AnalogPin.P1, angle)
    pins.i2cWriteNumber(
    32,
    256 + angle,
    NumberFormat.UInt16BE,
    false
    )
    basic.pause(500)
})
